_comment: Portable hook snippets for the git-flow-session-end module. Merge the `hooks` entries below into a host repo's .claude/settings.json (append to existing arrays if present). Stop: session_end_guard.py nudges the agent back onto the session-end loop when it tries to end a turn with a MERGED PR un-cleaned-up or an OPEN PR at the hand-off point (disable: SESSION_END_GUARD_DISABLED=1). PreToolUse: pre_pr_wrapup_nudge.py injects a one-time non-blocking additionalContext reminder when a `gh pr create` fires with no wrap-up surface loaded this session — the H5 trigger-strengthening follow-up (disable: WRAPUP_NUDGE_DISABLED=1). Both scripts ship with this module; the `[ -f ] || exit 0` guards make each entry a safe no-op until you vendor it, so the snippet is safe to paste before the scripts exist. Both FAIL OPEN (the Stop guard also honors stop_hook_active), so they can never loop or wedge a session. Paths assume modules are vendored under $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/modules/ (the VENDORING.md convention); adjust if your host vendors elsewhere. See the companion index.md 'Enforcement' section for the prose.
